_comment: [OPUS-4.8] COVERAGE RATCHET (sq-hbg7) — committed per-crate line-coverage FLOOR, reviewed in diffs exactly like the conformance ratchet counts in .github/workflows/ci.yml. CI runs scripts/coverage-gate.py --check-robust (sq-x4jy): it re-measures ONLY the sub-floor crates up to K=3 times and keeps the per-crate MAX (llvm-cov only undercounts), FAILING only if a crate is STILL below its floor after K independent measurements — a genuine regression.
Floor = floor(measured) - 2 (min 0): a small margin so run-to-run / toolchain noise never trips the gate. The floor only ever RISES (--seed will not lower it without --allow-lower).

Tiering: the FAST/MEDIUM crates are measured + gated PER-COMMIT; the heavy sparq-vectors 50k recall/diskann tests are EXCLUDED per-commit (measured in the NIGHTLY tier — see the .github/workflows/ci.yml coverage-nightly job and the per-crate notes below). No crate is silently dropped.
Floors with floor:0 are crates whose llvm-cov line% is a known measurement artifact (see each note) — they are guarded by the test-PRESENCE gate (bench/coverage-presence.json) instead of the % gate.
Regenerate after a deliberate coverage rise: scripts/coverage.sh && scripts/coverage-gate.py --seed target/coverage/coverage-summary.json

sparq-algos.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-bif.8: OPT-IN graph analytics (PageRank / degree centrality / WCC + label-propagation communities). Standalone crate (`default = []`, no opt-in features) measured with default features — its whole surface compiles in a default build. Measured line% 99.14 (575/580) over the inline src oracles + the new tests/topology_oracles.rs (dangling-node PageRank, disconnected/chain WCC+LP, all-singleton communities, NodeFilter::All literal path); floor = floor(measured) - 2 margin. Conservative work-box seed; CI's --check-robust is the ratchet of record.

sparq-cli.note: subprocess artifact: tests spawn the COMPILED binary (assert_cmd / CARGO_BIN_EXE), not the instrumented profile — line% is ~0 by construction, not a real gap. Presence-gated instead.

sparq-conformance.note: test-driver crate: the W3C suites run as the BINARIES (cargo run), so `cargo llvm-cov --package` (which runs cargo test) sees only a few unit tests. Low % is expected; floor 0.

sparq-core.nightly_note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-bjct: nightly_floor gates the NIGHTLY tier, whose measurement MERGES the W3C SPARQL + inference conformance BINARIES (they run as `cargo run`, not `cargo test`) into this crate's llvm-cov report — a higher number than the test-only per-commit `floor`. See scripts/coverage.sh measure_merged + the coverage-nightly job. Merged measurement 92.44% (test-only ~91.3%); floor = floor(measured) - 2 margin lands at the base floor here, so the binaries' contribution is documented + gated, not yet a higher number.

sparq-reason.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-qcnn.16: raised n3/mod.rs from 85.55% to 88.92% by adding direct unit tests for the previously uncovered time: builtins (time:hours/minutes/seconds, time:dayOfWeek, time:inSeconds forward+reverse, time:timeZone), log:langlit, and string:encodeForURI/encodeForFragID (cwm variants); also exercised the base_triples() iterator in incremental.rs. Lifted measured line% 89.23 -> 90.52 (default-feature cargo llvm-cov -p sparq-reason, matching scripts/coverage.sh); n3/mod.rs 85.17 -> 88.92. Mutant survivors: provably-equivalent defensive-bound guards (guard < 10_000, short-circuit &&) and the rayon parallel-sweep branch (requires 4096+ triples). floor = floor(measured) - 2 = 88. Conservative work-box seed; CI --check-robust is the ratchet of record.

sparq-reason-wasm.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-bif.1: tier-b WASM bundle (cdylib+rlib). Its gate-exercising surface is the #[wasm_bindgen] JS API exercised ONLY by `wasm-pack test --node` (tests/web.rs is #[wasm_bindgen_test]); a NATIVE `cargo llvm-cov` runs 0 of those and reports a misleadingly-low ~55% over the rlib helpers alone — a measurement artifact in the same class as sparq-cli (subprocess) / sparq-gpu (device-gated). Floor 0 + PRESENCE-gated (bench/coverage-presence.json) instead of an unenforceable %; not added to scripts/coverage.sh.

sparq-shacl.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-qcnn / sq-qcnn.1: measured with DEFAULT features (the per-commit tier — no measure() case arm; the opt-in shacl-af/scs surfaces are compiled out of a default build, so func.rs/scs.rs do not count toward this default-feature number). Raised 90 -> 93 by sq-qcnn (#993) SHACL-SPARQL §5.2/§6 coverage; sq-qcnn.1 then lifted sparql.rs 79% -> 94% with an in-src unit-test module (sparql::tests) over the DARK push_values_down deep-algebra arms (Group/Slice/Distinct/Reduced/OrderBy/Minus-left/LeftJoin-left, structural + semantic) and the fail-closed error paths of ask_violates/select_validate/PreparedSparql::evaluate/pre_bind_ask/PreparedValidator::build (non-SELECT/ASK skip, mismatched validator, inexpressible blank-node value, SERVICE runtime-query-error). Measured default-feature line% 95.48 (3798/3978); floor = floor(measured) - 2 = 93 (unchanged — floors only rise). The shacl-af func.rs and scs.rs gains are behind their opt-in features and so do NOT lift this default-feature floor. Conservative work-box seed; CI's --check-robust is the ratchet of record.

sparq-substrate.note: [OPUS-4.8] sq-qcnn.12 (epic sq-qcnn, umbrella sq-qonbz): the shared zero-overhead evaluation SUBSTRATE (correctness core). Its WHOLE surface is DEFAULT-OFF, so it is measured WITH --features numeric,join,compare,rows (the four features that turn the id-tuple Row/Key/Posting vocabulary, the XSD numeric value tower, the four id-tuple join kernels, and the SPARQL term total order ON — see scripts/coverage.sh measure() case; a default build is an empty crate). sq-qcnn.12 raised the floor 80 -> 96 by adding DIRECT, EXACT-VALUE unit tests over the numeric value tower (Dec parse_lexical/checked_add/sub/mul/div/cmp/round_to_int overflow + f64/lexical, Num binop tier promotion + overflow-to-double, neg/abs i64::MIN + i128::MIN overflow, ceil/floor/round/datatype/is_nan/is_zero all variants, float/double lexical + canonical_lexical) and the join kernels (JoinKeys projection, key_hash, build_partitioned + multi-partition probe_emit, merge_join Greater-arm + empty inputs, hash/lftj budget truncation, merge_rows bound-left, any_unbound), each asserting exact outputs so a comparison/arithmetic/branch mutation goes red. Measured line% 98.96 (1611/1628: rows.rs 100, compare.rs 96.23, join.rs 99.29, numeric.rs 99.17); floor = floor(measured) - 2 margin = 96. Conservative work-box seed; CI's --check-robust is the ratchet of record. Nothing in the workspace depends on this crate, so its unit tests are otherwise run ONLY by the feature-matrix leg — this brings the correctness core under the ratchet ('no crate silently dropped').
